Apartamenti ka rifinitura cilesore dhe elektroshtepiake shume te mira

title_en: 2+1+2+P apartment for sale on Bulevardi Ri
description_en: The apartment is located in a new building built in recent years with maximum quality, such as thermal dural ventilated facade, green areas, elevator and very good administration. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor facing east and is organized by a kitchen and living room, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a balcony. The apartment also has a parking post and a warehouse on level -1. The apartment has high-quality refinishing and very good electrical appliances. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation. For more information and to organize a visit to the property, contact us.
